summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer, strong background in web development and JavaScript frameworks (jQuery, Knockout.js), critical of Apple and its business practices, advocates for open-source software and freedom of choice in technology, prefers Android over iOS, engaged in discussions about software patents and copyright reform, interested in Linux and Unix systems, has experience with various programming languages (C#, PHP), expresses concerns about corporate monopolies and censorship in tech communities, values user control and customization in software, has a critical view of tech journalism and media narratives.
